title: A Smile
description: NCERT Class 2 English (Marigold): 'A Smile'. New words, comprehension, this, that, these, those, and a writing task, closed by a chapter test.

nodes.title: New Words
nodes.skill: Read and use the new words from 'A Smile': smile, happy, friend, share.
nodes.teach_focus: What the new words from 'A Smile' mean (smile, happy, friend, share); use one correctly in a short phrase.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses two or more of the chapter's new words correctly.
nodes.bridge_focus: Name just one new word and what it means.

bridge_exercises.context: Uses a new word in context.

bridge_exercises.sentence: A person you like and play with is a ___.
bridge_exercises.context: Checks the meaning of a key word.

exemplars: Those are the tall trees near the gate.

nodes.title: Read and Understand
nodes.skill: Understand the chapter 'A Smile' and answer a simple question about it.
nodes.teach_focus: The main idea and feeling of 'A Smile'; answer a who/what/how question about it in one clear sentence.
nodes.success_criteria: Answers a simple question about the chapter in one clear sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Say in one sentence what the chapter is about.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The poem says a smile grows when you ___ it.
A smile grows bigger when you ___ it with others.

exemplars: Those are the tall trees near the gate.

nodes.title: This, That, These, Those
nodes.skill: Use this, that, these, those correctly.
nodes.teach_focus: Use 'this/these' for things near you and 'that/those' for things far away.
nodes.success_criteria: Uses this, that, these, those correctly in a sentence.
nodes.bridge_focus: Give one example of this, that, these, those.

bridge_exercises.sentence: The book is far away. Which is correct?
___ is my pen, right here in my hand.
bridge_exercises.context: Produces the grammar point in a sentence.

exemplars: This is my pen, right here.
Those birds are flying far away.

nodes.title: Use It: Write a Sentence
nodes.skill: Write one sentence of your own using ideas from 'A Smile'.
nodes.teach_focus: Write one clear sentence about 'A Smile': who does what, with a capital letter and a full stop.
nodes.success_criteria: One complete sentence on the topic, with a capital and a full stop.

bridge_exercises.sentence: I share my ___ with my friends.
bridge_exercises.context: Scaffolds writing with a frame to complete.

bridge_exercises.sentence: ___ is my pen, right here in my hand.
bridge_exercises.context: A second frame to produce the chapter's grammar.

exemplars: Those are the tall trees near the gate.

items.prompt: A person you like and play with is a ___.
The poem says a smile grows when you ___ it.
A smile grows bigger when you ___ it with others.
The book is far away. Which is correct?
___ is my pen, right here in my hand.
